notes:
I went straight to Cartwheels Gym Centre's own site (12 Armstrong Ave., Georgetown) since that's the gym asked about. Here's what I found:

**The program exists.** 
Your child's first gym class is for the youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver, focusing on sensory and gross motor development, co-ordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun.
 This is their "Tiny Gym" class — the parent & tot offering. 
One-year-old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins.
 Eligibility for the next level up (Mini Gym) requires 
having just participated in Tiny Gym in the term prior, showing readiness to participate without a parent, or being already 3½ when registering — otherwise a child not yet three years plus six months prior to the term start date must register into Tiny Gym.
 So Tiny Gym covers roughly 1 to 3½ years, with a parent/caregiver in the room.

**Where it falls short.** The gym is explicit that 
availability and pricing are only available by logging into their Registration Website, since pricing fluctuates term by term.
 Nothing on their public pages gives a day, time, or a confirmed fall-term start date — those live behind their Uplifter registration portal, which needs an account to view.

Because I can't hand over a real day/time, session date, or price for this one — and I won't invent one — I'm not listing it as a full pick. It's a genuine program, just one whose schedule isn't public yet.
